Ava (People Ops): Hey team — new hire Samir starts Mon. He's relocating and can't make an in-person I-9 kiosk on day 0. Options: mobile notary + courier laptop pickup, or curbside badge + remote I-9 verification via e-verify exception. Can we confirm process?
Devon (IT): @Ava we can do curbside laptop handoff at 9:30 or 2pm. Need an escort and a signed receipt. Laptop image + asset tag recorded. :truck:
Maya (Onboarding): For mobile notary we need the notarized I-9 form + passport copy before day 1. Background check (Checkr) is still pending on address verification — candidate uploaded docs today.
Lina (People Ops): If Checkr address clears by Friday we can authorize remote I-9 exception and waive in-person for week1. If not, schedule mobile notary for Monday morning (I've flagged a notary vendor).
Ava (People Ops): Thanks. Courier question: can IT ship laptop to hotel and we do curbside transfer at hotel lobby? That avoids office badge concerns.
Devon (IT): We can ship to a verified hotel address but need confirmation from Samir and a signed release form. I'll prepare a one-page release PDF and a FedEx tracking. Example tracking: 6123 4567 8901.
Maya (Onboarding): Samir prefers hotel pickup. I'll email him the release and request passport scan + preferred pickup window. Also assigning Dana as day-1 buddy for orientation at 11:00.
CourierBot: Shipment label created: FEDEX-612345678901. Pickup scheduled Sat 18:00 local. Status: label printed. :white_check_mark:
Lina (People Ops): Action items: 1) @Devon prepare release + asset tag form; 2) @Maya confirm hotel address and send release; 3) Samir to upload notarized I-9 or confirm mobile notary slot. I'll book escort for curbside handoff once tracking shows 'in transit'.
Ava (People Ops): Sounds good. I'll follow up Fri AM if Checkr still pending. Samir, cc'd, please reply with hotel name/confirmation. :wave:
